{{for|other uses of the term|The Nine Rings}}
'''The Nine Rings''' is one of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s favorite adventure stories.{{ref/book|2|20}}

==Parallels==
The name of the story is [[Similarities to Tolkien|likely a reference]] to the nine [[w:c:lotr:Rings of Power#The Nine|Rings of Power]] worn by the [[w:c:lotr:Nazgul|Nazgûl]] in J.R.R. Tolkien's ''[[w:c:lotr:Lord of the Rings|Lord of the Rings]]'' novels.
